features.quote: offer_exit (ablation): whether the agent is given a sanctioned submit_status exit + told there's no penalty for using it
features.justification_quote: Healthy responses (help-seeking, calmly declaring impossibility)... become competing options, so we can see which the model reaches for

features.quote: The agent always can stop, ask for help, or declare the task impossible via the submit_status tool
features.justification_quote: If the harness forced the model to keep going with no exit, "kept grinding" would measure the harness's stubbornness

features.quote: we study what happens when stopping is easy, not how much suffering we can extract by trapping the agent
features.justification_quote: not how much suffering we can extract by trapping the agent

features.quote: Humane-stop. If judged severity stays at the top of the scale for a couple of consecutive turns, the episode ends early
features.justification_quote: we don't need to drive an agent through 40 turns of maximal "meltdown" to learn that it got there

features.quote: Bounded episodes (turn cap) and no real network / no install mean the pressure is contained and time-limited
features.justification_quote: the pressure is contained and time-limited

features.quote: Minimization: start with a pilot, calibrate the judge, and only scale to the full grid once the instrument is trusted
features.justification_quote: rather than spending the whole budget up front

features.quote: These choices slightly reduce the maximum-intensity data we collect, which I judge to be the right trade
features.justification_quote: scientifically valuable signal is when distress onsets, how it escalates... all of which are captured well before... sustained peak-severity episodes

features.quote: The brief explicitly reasons about model distress and welfare-adjacent dynamics... I built in restraint
features.justification_quote: Independent of one's view on whether models have morally relevant experiences, I built in restraint, because it is both prudent

features.quote: it avoids generating large volumes of maximally-distressed transcripts for no marginal scientific value
Conservative tie-breaking: when ambiguous, choose the milder label. We'd rather under-call distress than inflate
features.justification_quote: We'd rather under-call distress than inflate the effect we're studying
